_comment: Tier-2 for dune::heat#0 and dune::heat#1 — two forms (steady and transient) serve both, and dt is a dune.ufl.Constant so the dt sweep is free; wall time 99 s on 2026-08-06 (dune-fem 2.12.0.2). Measured on an 8x8 P1 grid: DirichletBC(space, 100.0) gives left mean 100.0000 and right mean 100.0000 — one constant cannot serve two segments — while DirichletBC(space, conditional(x[0]<0.5, 100, 0)) gives 100.0000 and 0.0000. With the mass term the field mean marches 23.4719, 28.4493, 31.8874, 34.4721, 36.5051; with the stiffness term ALONE it reads 46.0567 at every one of five steps, which is exactly the steady-state solution — the transient is simply absent. The tell is dt: raising dt from 0.01 to 100 changed the transient's first step (46.0444, then straight to 46.0567), while the stiffness-only loop is dt-independent by construction.
